one_liner: A complete customer service helpdesk system featuring human and AI support capabilities.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 for public integrations and static Bearer access tokens for private apps.
access_notes: Free development workspaces are available upon signup to obtain credentials.
api_notes: Covers contacts, tickets, help center, conversations, and reporting endpoints via api.intercom.io.
blocker_notes: Public APIs and free development workspaces are readily accessible.

auth.quote: To access the Intercom API, you have two authentication options depending on whether you app is public or private.

access.quote: Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.

api.quote: The Intercom Developer Platform is a suite of SDKs and APIs for building apps that connect with Intercom.

mcp.quote: Fin pulls in customer data and takes action through APIs or MCP.

verdict.quote: To develop a public app you will need to use a development workspace: sign up here to create your free account.

name: Intercom
queries: Intercom API access pricing plan developer

reasons.auth: Intercom supports OAuth2 for public apps and Bearer token (access token) for private apps, as documented in the Developer Hub.
reasons.access: A free 14‑day trial is available with no credit card required, and developers can create a free workspace to obtain credentials.
reasons.mcp: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is documented in the Intercom Developer Platform and is officially published by Intercom.
reasons.verdict: Public documentation, free trial, and self‑serve credentials allow a developer to build an integration today without additional hurdles.
